The proverbs of Solomon, the son of Davi: She looks well to the ways of her household,

PRO 1:1: and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

The proverbs of Solomon, the son of Davi: Her children rise up and call her blessed.
“Many women do noble things,
Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain;

PRO 1:1: but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

The proverbs of Solomon, the son of Davi: Give her of the fruit of her hands!

PRO 1:1: Let her works praise her in the gates!
